Name: (CP) Raspberry Bouquet Cursors
Author: thefangirlotaku
Description:
Yay, my first mod! This mod does exactly what it says on the tin. It uses Content Patcher to change the default game cursor to my Raspberry Bouquet cursor. It also changes the button cursors to Playstation format instead of XBox because I use a Playstation controller. If there is demand for a version with the original buttons I might add an option to switch between the two, but I'm still learning.
[u]Installation Instructions[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher installed. 
[*]Download (CP) Raspberry Bouquet Cursors into your StardewValley\Mods\ folder.
[*]Extract with [url=https://www.winzip.com/en/pages/download/winzip-v1/?x-target=bing&promo=bing&utm_id=267237932&msclkid=4cec237aa67e1da5dc334508afd20b68&utm_source=bing&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=0.00+Search+-+EN+-+Brand&utm_term=winzip+free+download&utm_content=1.01+%5Bwin+zip%5D&alid=304175739.1718749614]winzip[/url]﻿, [url=https://7-zip.org/]7zip[/url] or another file extracting software.
[*]You should be all good, babes!﻿
[/list]
